source.author: ov
source.text: Qua rursus visa, veluti praesaga futuri, horruit Alcyone lacrimasque emisit obortas amplexusque dedit, tristique miserrima tandem ore vale dixit collapsaque corpore toto est.
source.text_original: Qua rursus visa, veluti praesaga futuri, / horruit Alcyone lacrimasque emisit obortas / amplexusque dedit, tristique miserrima tandem / ore 'vale' dixit collapsaque corpore toto est.
source.text_english: When she saw him again, as though foreknowing the future, Alcyone shuddered and burst into tears, gave him embraces, and at last with sorrowful face said farewell; and then she sank down, utterly collapsed in body.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_original: da, precor, amplexus haesuraque verba relinque / auribus et dulci iam nunc preme lumina dextra.
reuse.text_english: Give me, I beg, your embrace, and leave your words to cling to my ears, and now at last close my eyes with your sweet right hand.
